season.evidence: Histogram Jul 64, Aug 54, Sep 40; web search: reports cluster early July to late August with a few in September; late-season glacier loss is the limit on neighbouring Clark. Stored Jul-Sep kept.

track.why: Logged route Boulder Basin standard / S/SW traverse from Clark, from White River TH; track start/end 14-17 m from our trailhead pin, summit 8 m; report describes the Clark-to-Luahna ledges, class 3/4 finish and exposed ledges matching our SW slope - SE ridge text. Mid-September is inside Jul-Sep.

facts.text: In mid-September the debris gully dropping from Clark sheds a lot of rock onto you; the higher traverse is safer.
Ledges near the top are sandy and strewn with loose flakes; test every hold before weighting it.
In mid-September the best low-impact camp is the saddle between Point 7970 and Clark, but water is scarce there, so carry some.
